- Next step: 60–90 minute technical deep-dive with our ML/Infra leads so we can: (1) validate expected workloads (qps, seq lengths), (2) walk through deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private), and (3) draft a mutual action plan with acceptance criteria.

Proposed windows (PDT):
- Tue 2026-10-20: 09:00–10:30 or 13:00–14:30
- Wed 2026-10-21: 11:00–12:30 or 15:00–16:30

I’ve cc’d Marissa (customer ops) and Ben (solutions/infra) to align on attendees and readouts. If none of those windows work, send 2 slots that do and we’ll accommodate.

Prep asks (short):
- Can you confirm attendee roles (security, infra, ML owner)?
- If possible, share current RPS and 95th percentile latency targets, and any infra constraints (cloud/on-prem/hybrid).

I’ll follow up with a tentative agenda and a light prep packet once we lock time.

Thanks — Aditya
